entries.question: Kya bsc radiotherapy technology aur bsc radiology same hi hai
entries.answer:
B.Sc. Radiotherapy Technology aur B.Sc. Radiology (Radiological Imaging Technology) takneeki roop se alag-alag field hain, halanki dono medical imaging aur radiation se sambandhit hain:

1. **B.Sc. Radiotherapy Technology:** Isme cancer ke upchar (treatment) ke liye radiation ka upyog kaise kiya jaye, is par dhyan kendrit kiya jata hai. Ismein aap cancer patients ko radiation dene wali machines (jaise Linear Accelerators) ko chalana seekhte hain.
2. **B.Sc. Radiology / Radiology Imaging Technology:** Ismein bimariyon ka pata lagane (diagnosis) ke liye imaging ka upyog kiya jata hai. Ismein aap X-ray, Ultrasound, CT Scan, aur MRI jaisi machines ka upyog karke body ke andar ki tasveerein lena seekhte hain.

KGMU ke exam notices mein aksar **B.Sc. Radiotherapy Technology** ka ullekh milta hai. Admission lene se pehle, main website [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) par jaakar 'Courses' section mein apne liye sahi course ka chayan avashya karein, kyunki dono ke career path aur padhai ka uddeshya alag hota hai.

entries.question: Medical cirtificate bnane btaye
entries.answer:
KGMU mein medical certificate banwane ke liye niche di gayi prakriya ka palan karein:

1. **OPD Registration:** Sabse pehle aapko KGMU mein OPD registration karwana hoga. Aap online (ORS - [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)) ya hospital mein jakar walk-in registration kar sakte hain. Registration shulk ₹50 hai.

4. **Certificate ke liye Anurodh:** Doctor ke upchar (treatment) ke baad, aap unse medical certificate ke liye anurodh kar sakte hain. Doctor apni clinical assessment ke aadhar par hi certificate jari karte hain.
5. **Office/Verification:** Certificate milne ke baad, kabhi-kabhi us par hospital ki official mohar (stamp) lagwani padti hai, jiske liye aapko PRO office ya hospital ke administrative vibhag se sampark karna pad sakta hai.

**Kuch Zaruri Baatein:**
*   Medical certificate sirf doctor ke mulyankan (assessment) par hi milta hai; yeh koi automatic ya paid service nahi hai.
*   Apne saath apni pehchan patra (Aadhaar card) aur purani medical reports jarur rakhein.
*   Agar aap kisi sarkari kaam ya chutti ke liye certificate chahte hain, toh uske liye nirdharit format lekar jayein.

4.  **Avoid Fraudulent Offers:** Please be extremely careful. There is no "management quota" or "direct admission" process at KGMU. Anyone promising you a seat in exchange for money is likely attempting to defraud you.

entries.question: Hi mujhe dr Sharad Chandra ko Monday ko dikhana h parcha lagana h kya kare ?
entries.answer:
Dr. Sharad Chandra ko dikhane ke liye aapko OPD mein parcha (registration) lagwana hoga. KGMU mein OPD ke liye online registration mandatory hai.

Aap niche diye gaye tarikon se appointment book kar sakte hain:

1.  **Online Registration (ORS):** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login/register karein, phir Uttar Pradesh select karke KGMU chunein. Department aur date select karke ₹50 ka shulk (fee) bharein aur slip download kar lein.
2.  **SMS dwara:** Apne mobile se `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likhkar 8887019134 par bhejein.
3.  **Walk-in:** Aap hospital jakar bhi parcha banwa sakte hain. Iske liye apna Aadhaar card aur active mobile number saath rakhein. OTP verification ke baad token milega aur ₹50 ka shulk dekar OPD slip prapt kar sakte hain.

**Kuch Zaruri Baatein:**
*   **Samay:** OPD ka samay Somvar (Monday) se Shukravar (Friday) tak subah 9:00 AM se 1:00 PM tak hai. Counter 1:00 PM par band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchein.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne saath us vishisht vibhag (Cardiology) ke liye valid referral letter zaroor rakhein.
*   **Sallah:** Bheed se bachne ke liye pahle se online booking karna behtar hai.

entries.question: Online booking kaise hota h ?
entries.answer:
KGMU mein online appointment book karne ke liye aap **ORS (Online Registration System)** ka upyog kar sakte hain. Iski prakriya (process) niche di gayi hai:

1.  **Website par jayein:** Sabse pehle apne browser mein [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) open karein.
2.  **Login/Register:** Agar aapka account nahi hai, toh apne mobile number se register karein (OTP aayega).
3.  **Hospital Select karein:** 'New Appointment' par click karein. State mein **'Uttar Pradesh'** aur fir Hospital list mein **'King George's Medical University (KGMU)'** ko chunein.
4.  **Department aur Date:** Jis vibhag (Cardiology) mein dikhana hai, use select karein aur uplabdh (available) date aur time chunein.
5.  **Patient Details:** Patient ka naam, umar, aur Aadhaar number (yadi maanga jaye) bharein.
6.  **Payment:** OPD slip ka shulk **₹50** hai. Ise online payment mode (UPI, Net Banking, ya Card) se bharein.
7.  **Slip Download:** Payment pura hone ke baad, appointment slip download kar lein ya uska print-out nikal lein.

**Kuch aur mahatvapurn jankari:**
*   Aap **'ABHA/Health Care App'** ka bhi upyog kar sakte hain, wahan bhi registration ki prakriya yahi hai.
*   Hospital pahunchne par wahi appointment slip dikhakar aap apna parcha (OPD ticket) counter se le sakte hain.
*   **Dhyan dein:** OPD ka samay subah 9:00 baje se 1:00 baje tak hota hai, isliye apne appointment ke samay se thoda pehle hospital pahunchna behtar rehta hai.

Main ek AI chatbot hoon, isliye apni suraksha ke liye chat mein apna koi bhi personal data (jaise Aadhaar number, phone number, ya patient ke medical records) share na karein.
